case_selection_rule: In frozen evaluation pair order: first positive vision-minus-text gain; first negative gain; first zero gain with vision TOP_OUT. Missing categories stay empty. No narrative-based reselection.

method.population: Only the 48 formal episodes on 24 paired seeds. Calibration excluded. Repeated actions are not independent samples.
method.geometry: Reuse V6 inspect_episode: only target.rotation==active.rotation is checkable. Width=max(active.cells.x)-min(active.cells.x)+1; target left+width>10 or left<0 proves horizontal out-of-bounds.
method.choice_distributions: Post-hoc complete choice-ID counts: every Decision goal call, including keep/clear if present, and every executed native action including its duration. No center-only filtering or grouping. Repeated goals/actions are not independent samples and concentration alone does not prove causality.
method.geometry_limits: Other rotations are untested. Passing the boundary test does not prove reachability, safety, good placement or line clearing.
method.stall: No-x-change requires unchanged piece/type/rotation and minimum occupied x; falling is allowed. This alone does not prove wall collision.
method.boundary_stall: A no-x-change horizontal action toward an already contacted board edge (left min x=0, right max x=9). Other stalls may involve timing or locked pieces; not labeled wall collision.
method.locked_piece_count: (locked cells after - before + 10*newly cleared lines)/4. Hold is not a lock and TOP_OUT alone is not a lock.
method.board_profile: Locked cells only, including spawn rows y=-2,-1. Height=20-top occupied y; a hole is an empty cell below a locked cell in the same column. Active cells excluded.
method.causality: Read-only, post-hoc behavior descriptions. Do not establish the causal mechanism of an image effect and do not replace the registered paired score interval.
method.scope: No model calls, source/policy edits, filtering of actions, independent extra trials, score changes or promotion.
